abstract: While the global space economy continues to rapidly grow, and public policy challenges related to satellites and debris in orbit emerge, there is surprisingly little evidence connecting theoretical economic frameworks with observed orbital usage. Using a state-of-the-science integrated assessment model combining economic modeling with physical models of the space environment, we find the observed distribution of satellite orbits is well-explained by profit-maximizing satellite operator behavior. Furthermore, we find strong evidence that collision risk plays a key deterrence role. Finally, the observed location of the largest satellite constellation, Starlink, is consistent with a “sole owner” over particularly economically desirable altitudes.
abstract_zh: 全球太空经济继续快速增长，与轨道卫星和碎片有关的公共政策挑战不断显现，但将理论经济学框架与实际轨道使用联系起来的证据却出人意料地稀少。本文使用一个结合经济模型与太空环境物理模型的前沿综合评估模型，发现观测到的卫星轨道分布可以由卫星运营商利润最大化行为很好地解释。进一步结果表明，碰撞风险发挥了重要的威慑作用。最后，最大卫星星座 Starlink 的实际部署位置，与其在经济价值尤其高的轨道高度上表现为“单一所有者”的行为相一致。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Do economic principles explain orbital use in space?
title_zh: 经济原理能否解释太空轨道利用？

abstract: Abstract Climate change is predicted to have large and heterogeneous impacts on agricultural yields. I use a model of production, consumption, and trade of 24 crops between 271 regions across sub-Saharan Africa to simulate the effects of climate change and explore how trade mediates these effects. I estimate a continent-wide welfare loss equivalent to 2.4% of GDP using median yield changes across 5 climate models, with country-level losses up to 60% of GDP in the worst model. The continent-wide welfare loss is 19% smaller with lower trade costs and over 7 times larger if trade flows are capped at current levels.

<jats:p>气候变化预计将对农业产量产生巨大且异质性的影响。本文利用一个涵盖撒哈拉以南非洲271个地区、24种作物生产、消费与贸易的模型，模拟气候变化的影响，并探讨贸易如何调节这些效应。基于5个气候模型的中位产量变化，我估算出全大陆福利损失相当于GDP的2.4%，而在最差模型下，国家层面的损失高达GDP的60%。当贸易成本较低时，全大陆福利损失减少19%；若贸易流量被限制在当前水平，损失则扩大7倍以上。</jats:p>

abstract: Firm heterogeneity in financial constraints is a quantitatively important driver of how monetary policy transmits to inflation. Using detailed microdata on Swedish public and private firms, and high-frequency monetary policy surprises around Riksbank announcements, we document that smaller, financially constrained firms adjust prices significantly less than larger firms in response to changes in monetary policy. This heterogeneous price response materially dampens the aggregate PPI inflation response to monetary policy. Models of customer markets and financial frictions can explain our findings: because the external finance premium rises after a monetary contraction, constrained firms cut prices less to preserve cash flows, sacrificing future market share. Additional evidence on heterogeneous sales, debt, marginal cost, and markup responses further supports this channel. We consider several alternative explanations, including differences in price adjustments, working capital, market share, and export share, but these cannot explain our main heterogeneity result.
abstract_zh: 企业融资约束的异质性在货币政策向通胀传导过程中具有重要的定量意义。基于瑞典上市与非上市企业的微观数据，结合瑞典央行公告前后高频货币政策意外冲击，我们发现：相较于大型企业，规模较小且面临融资约束的企业在应对货币政策变化时，其价格调整幅度显著更低。这种异质性价格响应实质上削弱了货币政策对总体生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀的影响。客户市场模型与金融摩擦理论可解释这一发现：由于货币紧缩后外部融资溢价上升，受约束企业为维持现金流而减少降价幅度，从而牺牲未来市场份额。关于销售额、债务、边际成本及加成率异质性的额外证据进一步支持该传导渠道。我们考察了包括价格调整成本、营运资本、市场份额及出口份额在内的多种替代性解释，但这些因素均无法解释核心异质性结论。
authors: Michael Bauer; Alexander Czarnota; Mathias Klein

abstract: Abstract We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky (1972)) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of Diagnostic Expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，Gennaioli 和 Shleifer（2010）对 Kahneman 和 Tversky（1972）所提出的代表性概念的形式化，与不确定性和过度反应之间存在内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们在诊断性预期（DE）的平滑版本中发展了这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观而言，在平滑条件下，较低的不确定性为代表性扭曲信念留下的空间更小。平滑诊断性预期为调查数据的若干关键特征提供了统一且简约的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、在更长期限上更强的过度反应、对主观不确定性的过度自信，以及本文记录的一个新典型事实，即不确定性越高，过度反应越强。一个结合平滑诊断性预期的解析性真实经济周期模型，既能解释调查数据中的过度反应和过度自信，也能解释商业周期的三个显著特征：不对称性、宏观波动的逆周期性以及微观波动的逆周期性。
title: Smooth Diagnostic Expectations

abstract: Focus Exuberance about new technologies often brings about investment booms. The race among firms to capture a share of the revenues can result in excessive investment that makes the boom prone to a disruptive end. The boom-bust cycle recurs across history, from the canal and railway manias of the 19th century to the dotcom boom of the 1990s. The current artificial intelligence (AI) build-out ranks among the largest technology-driven investment booms in US history. Could it share the same fate as prior episodes?
abstract_zh: 对新技术的狂热关注常常引发投资热潮。企业为争夺收入份额而展开的竞争可能导致过度投资，使热潮容易以破坏性结局收场。从19世纪的运河与铁路狂热到20世纪90年代的互联网泡沫，繁荣-萧条周期在历史上反复出现。当前的人工智能基础设施建设规模，堪称美国历史上规模最大的技术驱动型投资热潮之一。它是否会重蹈此前历次热潮的覆辙？
title: The AI investment race

abstract: How much did France pay for its colonial empire? Did colonies benefit from large transfers from French taxpayers and private investors, or were they, on the contrary, drained of their capital? This paper uses novel budgetary, private investment, and loan data to compute monetary flows between France and the colonies between 1833 and 1962. Public expenditure spent by France on the empire represented only 1.3 percent of its GDP, of which four-fifths was for the military. Trade balance deficits of French colonies were not counterbalanced by large public or private capital transfers from France to the colonies, but by military expenditure from the metropole. Overall, large sums of money were flowing from the colonies to the metropole, a “drain” representing a couple of percentage points of colonial GDP, making French colonies comparable to British India in the twentieth century.
abstract_zh: 法国为其殖民帝国付出了多少代价？殖民地是否从法国纳税人和私人投资者的大规模转移中获益，还是相反，其资本被抽空？本文利用1833年至1962年间法国与殖民地之间新的预算、私人投资和贷款数据，计算了双方的资金流动。法国在帝国上的公共支出仅占其GDP的1.3%，其中五分之四用于军事。法国殖民地的贸易逆差并未通过法国向殖民地的大规模公共或私人资本转移来弥补，而是由宗主国的军事支出所抵消。总体而言，大量资金从殖民地流向宗主国，这种“抽血”相当于殖民地GDP的几个百分点，使得法国殖民地在20世纪与英属印度具有可比性。
title: Colonialism on the Cheap: The French Empire 1830–1962
title_zh: 廉价殖民主义：法兰西帝国（1830–1962）

abstract: The EU Recovery and Resilience Facility was launched to support post-Covid recovery while accelerating structural transformation through investment and reform. This column provides a preliminary descriptive assessment of the macroeconomic impact of the facility in Italy, Greece, and Spain, three countries with large allocations. Using simple counterfactual comparisons, it presents evidence consistent with a positive impact on real GDP, and an even stronger impact on employment and investment in the three countries. The evidence also points to an expected positive impact on potential output in the years ahead.
abstract_zh: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金旨在支持疫情后经济复苏，同时通过投资与改革加速结构性转型。本专栏对意大利、希腊和西班牙这三个获得大额拨款的国家的基金宏观经济影响进行了初步描述性评估。通过简单的反事实比较，研究提供了与三国实际GDP正向影响相一致的证据，且对就业和投资的促进作用更为显著。证据还表明，该基金有望在未来几年对潜在产出产生积极影响。
title: The macroeconomic impact of the Recovery and Resilience Facility: An analysis for Italy, Spain, and Greece
title_zh: 复苏与韧性基金对宏观经济的影响：意大利、西班牙和希腊的分析

abstract: The idea of equal cumulative emissions per person is simple: every individual should have an equal claim on the atmosphere regardless of where they live. Using historical population and emissions data from 1870 onward, this column examines how the world’s remaining carbon budget could be allocated fairly across countries. European states have already consumed more than their share, whereas many developing countries retain positive claims. Allocating the remaining budget fairly can be compatible with development goals if developing countries can access cleaner technologies. Europe can start by redesigning the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism to embed explicit fairness principles.
abstract_zh: 人均累计排放量平等的理念简洁明了：无论居住何地，每个人都应平等享有对大气资源的权利。本文基于1870年以来的历史人口与排放数据，探讨如何在全球剩余碳预算中实现国家间的公平分配。欧洲国家已超额消耗其份额，而众多发展中国家仍保有正向权益。若发展中国家能够获取清洁技术，公平分配剩余碳预算可与可持续发展目标兼容。欧洲可率先改革碳边境调节机制，将明确的公平原则嵌入其中。
title: Climate fairness, economic development, and Europe’s responsibility
title_zh: 气候公平、经济发展与欧洲的责任
